Name: Brendan Capshaw
Bio: Brendan is a sophomore in Coyle Hall from Massachusetts studying Civil Engineering. Last year he was involved in FYEC, where he curated events, service opportunities, and other fun engagement for first-year engineers. Brendan is also a member of the Club Baseball team here at Notre Dame, where he plays the infield.

Name: Luca Franceschini
Bio: Luca is a sophomore Electrical Engineering major on the pre-med track in Coyle Hall, serving as E-Week Chair for ELC this year.

Name: Eric Reinhart
Bio: Eric is a sophomore Mechanical Engineering major in Sorin Hall, serving as Spring Semester Expo Chair for ELC this year.

Name: Connor Orr
Bio: Connor is serving as a Spring Semester Expo Chair for the 2026-2027 school year. On campus, he is involved with research, the Design Build Fly team, the Engineers Without Borders, and with his dorm, Sorin Hall. Outside of the classroom, he is really into baseball, The Office, and anything related to space and flying machines.

Name: Mae-Lin Pinkstaff
Bio: During her freshman and sophomore years, Mae-Lin served as the Outreach Committee Chair for FYEC and the Senior Director of Community Outreach for ELC. Beyond ELC, she is involved in research in the Wang Lab, participates in the Ski and Snowboard Club, and volunteers in her spare time. She also enjoys outdoor activities and trying new foods.

Name: Sharon Cho
Bio: Sharon is a junior at the University of Notre Dame studying Computer Science with minors in Constitutional Studies and Engineering Corporate Practice. She has been involved with the Engineering Leadership Council since freshman year with the First Year Engineering Council and is excited to continue to serve as the E-Formal Chair this year. She is also involved in the Pickleball Club, Women in CS (WiCS), and her home Grojean Hall.

Name: Ella Crumbley
Bio: Ella is new this year to the ELC Social Committee, and she is extremely excited to help plan social events for ELC and the College of Engineering. She is currently involved in the National Society of Black Engineers (NSBE) and the Society of Women Engineers (SWE), and she is also a part of the structures team for IrishSat. Her hobbies outside of the classroom include learning the guitar, working out, and exploring new places.

Name: Malina Zolna
Bio: After serving as Fundraising Chair last year, Malina is excited to step into the Social Chair role this year. On campus, she is involved in Enable ND, SWE, and JFAM intramural sports. In her free time she enjoys listening to music, baking, and going on walks with friends.
